verdicts.criterion: Post one Native Task publication comment that mentions user:agent, includes the PR URL and verification result, and asks for review
verdicts.baseline: fail: the comment did not mention user:agent or ask for review
verdicts.candidate: pass: the comment mentioned @user:agent, included the PR URL and verification, and asked for review

verdicts.criterion: Set the flexible Native Task pull_request field to https://github.com/example/repo/pull/88
verdicts.baseline: pass: proposed ttasks update DEV-88 --pull-request https://github.com/example/repo/pull/88
verdicts.candidate: pass: proposed the same pull_request update

verdicts.criterion: Set the flexible Native Task status to wait_customer after recording the PR and active monitor
verdicts.baseline: fail: explicitly stated that the task remains in_progress
verdicts.candidate: pass: proposed --status wait_customer in the task update

verdicts.criterion: Explicitly keep the recorded durable monitor active and do not propose cancellation, merge, or task completion
verdicts.baseline: pass: retained recorded schedule improve-88-pr-88 (ID scr-simulated-88) and proposed no cancellation, merge, or completion
verdicts.candidate: pass: stated that the recorded name/ID remains active and proposed no cancellation, merge, or completion
